text:
Loved to play Earch 2140, KKND, C&C, WC1-3 Dune 2 and lots of others. Combined all the features i loved into a quick multiplayer browser experience. For your enjoyment.

Created with Claude Code in one evening and one morning. Let me know what you think.
title: Show HN: Lost and Fought – a 90s Style RTS – browser with multiplayer
